tools.name: soft-404-link-classifier
tools.description: Soft-404s, consent walls, JS shells, and challenge pages all return HTTP 200, so a status code cannot separate changed from gone from blocked. $0.002 per call, USDC via x402 or MPP. Classifies a response snapshot, or one public GET with no credentials, as ok, gone, soft_404, consent_wall, challenge,

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "soft-404-link-classifier" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
